messages.author: 3ad47e634b9b2960
messages.subject: Print only parameters (not generated quantities)?
parts:
Hi all,

I'm using Pystan -- is there a way to print(fit) only the parameters and not the generated quantities? I have several (very long) generated quantities and printing takes over an hour.

Thanks!
Tor

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Print only parameters (not generated quantities)?

How many variables and how many draws? I don't know how efficient the
PyStan code is for printing---it'd be nice to see if the time was in
the actual posterior statistics calculations or in the print itself.

- Bob
